name: Plaza Carranza
summary: Plaza Carranza is a modest indoor shopping center in Mexicali that attracts local residents with its varied mix of fashion boutiques, dining options including Burger King, and a popular movie theater. The center serves as a convenient community destination with telecommunications services and accessible hours.
demographics: Plaza Carranza primarily serves middle-income families and young adults in the Mexicali metropolitan area, with a strong representation of local residents seeking convenient shopping and entertainment options. The trade area draws from the surrounding Plutarco Elías Calles neighborhood and broader Mexicali region, attracting shoppers who value accessibility and a mix of affordable fashion, dining, and services. Typical visitors include families with children visiting the movie theater, young professionals shopping at boutiques like D'YABOO and FRAICHE, and students seeking mobile phone services and quick-service dining options like Burger King.
description: Plaza Carranza stands as a welcoming indoor shopping destination in the heart of Plutarco Elías Calles, Mexicali, serving the local community with a diverse mix of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Located at 2000 Boulevard Lázaro Cárdenas, this modest yet vibrant shopping center has become a popular gathering place for residents seeking convenient access to fashion boutiques, essential services, and family-friendly entertainment. The center features an appealing tenant mix that includes women's fashion retailers like D'YABOO, COLETTE BOUTIQUE, ISHA BOUTIQUE, and LOVE, alongside men's apparel at CONCRETE and unisex options at FRAICHE. Dining options range from quick-service favorites like Burger King to local treats at LA NUEVA MICHOACANA, while the on-site movie theater provides entertainment for families and moviegoers. With telecommunications services from TELCEL and MOVISTAR, along with convenient operating hours from 10 AM to 8 PM daily, Plaza Carranza has established itself as a reliable community hub that combines shopping convenience with leisure activities, earning a solid 4.2-star rating from nearly 10,000 reviews.
